title: helm(private): make KMS optional + allow tolerations/nodeAffinity for init hooks and values schema validation
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Private deployments sometimes run in environments without cloud KMS or where KMS is managed by an external operator. The init-hook jobs also need nodeAffinity/tolerations to schedule on dedicated control-plane nodes in air-gapped clusters. This PR: 1) makes the KMS fields optional in values.schema.json while preserving validation for when provided; 2) surfaces tolerations/nodeAffinity in values.yaml and templates for init hooks and controller; 3) updates templating to avoid rendering empty KMS blocks; 4) improves upgrade/rollback hooks to be idempotent and tolerate partial failures; 5) adds chart tests and docs. Includes migration notes and upgrade checklist. Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json updated - [x] templates updated (init-hook, hooks/upgrade) - [x] chart tests added (ct) - [x] README/upgrade notes updated - [x] manual upgrade verified on staging Changes are backwards compatible: KMS is still accepted; existing clusters with KMS will be unaffected. Upgrade notes included at the bottom.
